<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex115012026-09-1001-19-47" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
         <milestone n="Colophon (249a3-249a4)" unit="section"/>
        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5487"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3746">theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan</rs> gyi <expan>rnam par</expan> bshad pa theg chen rab gsal snang ba</rs> zhes pa ¦ 
        sdom rtson sde snod 'dzin pa mang pos snga mo nas bskul zhing ¦ khyad par du'ang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5965">dge ba'i <lb n="249a4"/> bshes gnyen chen po khaMs pa <note type="gloss">'gri gung</note> lo tsa ba ma Ni <note type="gloss">nor bu dpal gyi <expan>ye shes</expan></note> kashrI dz+nyA na</rs>s yang yang du bskul ba'i ngor ¦ 
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4128">bod kyi paN+Ti ta <note type="gloss">gnas lnga rig pa</note> <note type="gloss"><expan>blo gros</expan> rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pas</note>ma ti r+hwa dza shrI bha t+ra</rs>s ¦ <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5736">dge ldan sa bzangs</rs> su sbyar ba'o || 
        bstan pa <expan>rin po che</expan> dang <expan>sems can</expan> mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig || 
        maM galaM bha wa tu |<note type="editorial">In dbu can</note> 
      </seg></TEI>
